press_references.value: Better sues Vishal Garg over alleged securities violations

legal_proceedings.description: Better Home & Finance Holding filed a federal lawsuit against former CEO Vishal Garg, alleging securities-law violations involving undisclosed shareholder coordination and improper proxy solicitation. Better is seeking declaratory and injunctive relief, including corrected disclosures and invalidation of consents obtained through the alleged solicitation.

press_references.value: Better Mortgage settles underwriter overtime lawsuit for $7.185M

legal_proceedings.description: Better Mortgage agreed to pay $7.185 million to settle a nearly six-year federal wage-and-hour lawsuit alleging it misclassified mortgage underwriters as exempt and failed to pay overtime, resolving claims for 211 current and former underwriters plus related California PAGA claims.
